tailLossBehavior: The one-key release requires the exact installed v2 anchor, complete immutable baseline, current SQL registered local operations, and a genuine Account-aborted first-NEW source. It writes only the SQL-issued RELEASED reservation bytes and removes only that operation's exact original binding field. The terminal V2 value retains its original reservation coverage tuple and installed anchor; its inventoryRevision is the frozen SQL release-preparation source revision P. A later durable SQL receipt advances the current inventory clock to fresh revision R and links P, exact postimage, independent readback, and the original operation. Missing baseline/header, legacy or malformed values, unknown fields, conflicting or newer members, wrong reservation/anchor/incarnation, or changed source fail closed. RELEASE_PENDING remains capacity-counted until exact readback and the guarded SQL completion; only a retained completed RELEASED postimage is excluded from ordinary capacity. No coverage acknowledgement, barrier, or admission authority is produced.
